description: With no work named, first read the query as an exact reference (an ELI, a CELEX, an EU act's name, a Memorial citation, a historical identifier, a permalink, or a citation of an article of an act at a date) and answer the address its act opens at, the acts it may name, or a typed refusal; otherwise search the held Luxembourg article text its rights admit (text they withhold is not matched), strict or relaxed, with the quotes that answer; for one EU work named by identifier, its held wording.
name: search
